raw_text: OSINT monitoring of the NE India anti-CAA protests shows remarkable coordination. Over 40 Telegram groups activated within a 3-hour window with identical messaging templates. Protest routes, barricade locations, and legal aid contacts shared simultaneously. This level of coordinated mobilization is unusual for the region and suggests centralized planning.
